description: Events with a recorded human review, run by nre/event_acquire.py. An attestation is added only after the project owner signs off on that item; an unattested item keeps the event quarantined (reasons reported, no labels computed). recorded_result pins the digest of an accepted run's derived labels so a later run detects upstream data drift. Raw prices are never stored here.

attestation.scope: Authorizes provider.research_permitted:true for this project's specific, current use (redacted-anchor derived ratios/booleans/counts/hashes only, never raw prices). The 'aggregate at scale' question is explicitly carried forward as something to revisit as the cohort grows, not closed by this decision.

source.text: GlobeNewswire release, 'Solésence Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results', displayed dateline March 31, 2026 08:02 ET. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/03/31/3265441/12101/en/sol%C3%A9sence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results.html

first_public_time.basis: Project owner sign-off ('okay sign off'), accepting the residual chronology gap that open-web search cannot close.

historical_identity.basis: Project owner sign-off ('okay sign off'), accepting the residual chronology gap that open-web search cannot close.

corporate_actions.basis: Project owner sign-off ('yes, sign off on both') on two independent clean signals: no Item 3.03/5.03 SEC filing near the window, and an empty, fully paginated Alpaca response.

caveats.note: Accepted residual chronology gap: Open-web research can show no discoverable earlier disclosure; it cannot prove a negative for something that may have been said live and unrecorded (e.g. at an unindexed investor meeting) with zero public trace. This is the residual, irreducible uncertainty a human sign-off is being asked to accept, not a gap more searching would close.

first_public_time.basis: Project owner sign-off ('sign off on cxt').

historical_identity.basis: Project owner sign-off ('sign off on cxt').

corporate_actions.basis: Resolved by fetching the real action (cash dividend, ex-date 2026-02-27) and feeding it to the pipeline, which suppresses only the labels it crosses, rather than by a sign-off on an unverified count; the project owner directed the resolution ('resolve the dividend').

caveats.note: Competing catalyst: an Item 7.01 8-K filed 2026-02-25 discloses an Investor Day with an updated 2026 financial outlook and 2028 targets (content not reviewed); it falls inside the 20-session window at about session 10. Day-1, session-2 and session-5 labels mature before it.
